description:
You are the Director of Analytics for the Tri-City ValleyCats baseball team. A JSON file containing mid-season player statistics and coaching notes is located at /home/ga/Documents/team_stats_2024.json. Your task is to create a professional mid-season performance report in Apache OpenOffice Writer named '/home/ga/Documents/ValleyCats_MidSeason_2024.odt'. 

The report must include:
1. A Title Page/Section with the team name and report period.
2. An auto-generated Table of Contents.
3. Proper section structure using 'Heading 1' for main sections (e.g., Executive Summary, Offense, Pitching) and 'Heading 2' for subsections.
4. A Batting Statistics table including at least Player Name, AVG, HR, and RBI for all position players listed in the JSON.
5. A Pitching Statistics table including at least Pitcher Name, ERA, W-L, and Saves for all pitchers listed in the JSON.
6. Analytical commentary text in the body referencing specific players (e.g., mention 'Espinoza' or 'Pittman') and their stats.
7. Page numbers added to the footer.

Save the final document as a ODF Text Document (.odt).
